title: The Shy Fly
lines: A shy fly zips by Tim.
Tim will try to catch it.
The fly lands on his dry hat.
Tim grabs, and the fly is in the sky.
Tim sits in the dry grass. He is sad.
Mom asks him why he is so sad.
Tim tells Mom he lost his pet fly.
The fly lands on his hand and Tim grins.

questions.ask: Where did the fly land at the end?
questions.listenFor: On Tim's hand. Stated in the last few lines - have them find it rather than telling them.
He thought he had lost his pet fly. If they say "it went in the sky," that is the same idea - accept it.

questions.ask: Do you think a fly can be a pet? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: No right answer. You are listening for a reason of their own - and it is a fun one to argue about.
